findings.evidence: Line 113 declares `@[expose] noncomputable def Hom.ofMapWeightSpace`, while lines 129–133 already provide the characteristic `toLinearMap` theorem.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` and prove the projection lemma without exposing the body, e.g. use `:= (rfl)` as needed for controlled reducibility.
findings.issue: `Hom.ofMapWeightSpace` is marked `@[expose]` even though consumers are given `Hom.ofMapWeightSpace_toLinearMap`; this unnecessarily makes the constructor body part of the usable API.

findings.evidence: Lines 146–147 rewrite `f (weightProj … v)` to `weightProj … (f v)`; the parallel comodule naturality lemmas `Hom.map_coact_eq` and `Hom.map_coact_apply` in `Comodule/Basic.lean:166–174` are both `[simp]`.
findings.issue: `Hom.map_weightProj` is the canonical naturality normal form but lacks `@[simp]`, so simplification will not move a comodule morphism through a weight projection.

summary: The public weight-map API unnecessarily exposes an implementation body and omits the expected simplification rule for projection naturality.
